title: Aubergine and bean parmigiana
summary: Aubergine and bean parmigiana is a italian dinner built around aubergines and canned cannellini beans, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Aubergine and bean parmigiana into even pieces and toss canned cannellini beans with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of canned cannellini beans while you season aubergines. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle aubergines and passata among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Aubergine and bean parmigiana before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Aubergine and bean parmigiana into warm bowls with the juices.
